blast_radius.question: were the torpedo stream's bombers exposed to the same re-resolution
blast_radius.answer: not in these runs, and not for a reason the fix changes: USN04 builds no torpedo task at all - 'no ordered aircraft carries torpedo ordnance (kind 2Bh), so 0099A170 builds no kind Eh task'. The rule is per-unit and category-blind, so any unit with a category-1 or -2 row was exposed the moment a later row appeared.

runs.result: same walk as usn04_target.log; the aim trace resolves the two hypotheses.
runs.finding: the dive begins with the target 179.9 degrees behind at 443.3 m, and that entry range is the CLOSEST the aircraft ever gets - the range rises monotonically to 1752 m. The roll is not too slow; nothing ever pointed the aircraft at its target. The bank thrashing (+2.98, -3.03, +1.75, -0.89, ...) is the falling roll map limit-cycling on a bearing whose sign flips as the aircraft rolls past inverted.

Its command census: 009C69B1/009C69B9 cmd+2C4h with the mode, 009C6DE7/009C6DEF cmd+2C0h the commanded heading with the mode, 009C6F89/009C6F91 cmd+2BCh with the pitch mode, 009C6FF1/009C6FFB cmd+2D8h = 1 and cmd+2B4h.
